final: WITH c AS (SELECT powerstatus, COUNT(*) AS n FROM telescopes GROUP BY powerstatus), s AS (SELECT powerstatus, n, 100.0*n/(SELECT SUM(n) FROM c) AS share FROM c), a AS (SELECT AVG(share) AS avgshare FROM s) SELECT SUM(s.n) AS total_telescopes, AVG(s.share) AS avg_share, AVG(s.share - a.avgshare) AS avg_excess_over_avg FROM s, a WHERE s.share > a.avgshare
